name: Simple Radio Forty Two
author: Thomas Lloancy

sections.description:
Simple Radio Forty Two is a minimalist yet powerful radio player plugin for WordPress, inspired by Radio 42. Built with Vanilla JavaScript, it ensures zero dependencies and lightning-fast loading times.

The player features a unique “Smart Buffer” system that synchronizes with your page load and a Click Lock mechanism to prevent interface spamming, providing a seamless listening experience.

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Settings > Simple Radio Forty Two to configure your radio player.
  2. Enter your radio stream URL, choose the design and customization options.
  3. Customize the style via the provided CSS file or by adding rules in your theme.

Usage

  • Add the radio player to your content with the [sr42_radio] shortcode or via the widget in your sidebar.

License

Simple Radio Forty Two is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See LICENSE.txt for details.

Acknowledgments

Thanks to the WordPress community and the Radio 42 developers for the inspiration.
sections.installation:
1. Download the Simple Radio Forty Two ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Why is there a “Please Wait” message at startup?

This is the Smart Buffer. It locks the interface for 5 seconds to allow the browser to properly cache the initial audio stream.

Does it support mobile devices?

Yes. The player is fully responsive and optimized for touch controls.
sections.changelog:
1.3

  • Way cleaner UI although there’s probably some more works and studies to do on that matter.
  • Final stable release for WordPress 6.9.
  • Integrated Icecast metadata (Artist/Title) via AJAX.
  • Added “Laser Glow” visual effect on the volume slider.
  • Synchronized initial buffer with page load cycle.

1.2.3

  • Simple Radio Forty Two now uses plain js only and 4 predefined radio stations.
  • Added Click Lock mechanism to prevent UI spamming.

1.2.2

  • Fixed shortcode detection bug.
  • Updated compatibility for WordPress 6.7.
  • Documentation improvements and version clarification.

1.2.1

  • Bug fixed in 1.2.2 but never pushed to WordPress due to missing main PHP file version update.

1.2

  • Fixed background image filename (background.gif instead of background.png).
  • Improved JavaScript logic to avoid errors on pages without the shortcode.
  • Minor UI improvements.

1.0

  • First stable version.
  • Added basic radio player.
  • Basic customization options.
